info.name: Returns a list of congressional record issues sorted by most recent.

params.name: format
params.description: The data format. Value can be xml or json.

params.name: offset
params.description: The starting record returned. 0 is the first record.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of records returned. The maximum limit is 250.

params.name: y
params.description: The year the issue was published. For example, the value can be 2022.

params.name: m
params.description: The month the issue was published. For example, the value can be 6.

params.name: d
params.description: The day the issue was published. For example, the value can be 28.

items.docs: Returns a list of congressional record issues sorted by most recent.
